ふぅ……それで、犯人は誰だったの？\nこんなことをするなんて、うちに恨みがある奴: Phew... So, who was the culprit? Did someone with a grudge against us really do all this?
いや、どうも違うみたいでな……: No, that doesn't seem to be the case...
そう言って捕まえた生徒を見せると、\nエヴィが驚いた表情を浮かべる。: Saying that, I present the student I caught, causing Evi's eyes to widen in surprise.
……榊野ヒイロ！？\nは！？ え！？ 嘘！？ なんでこんなことを！？: ...Hiiro Sakakino!? Huh!? What!? No way!? Why would you do something like this!?
名前は聞いたことがあるな……有名人なのか？: I've heard that name before... Is she famous?
スカラ校舎でも、かなり有名なパイロット。\n何せ、たったひとりでチームとして認め: She's a pretty famous pilot even over at the Skalla campus. After all, she got recognized as a team all by herself.
そう……普通なら認められないけどさ。\nそれで実際にメイズに潜って実績を出してる: Yeah... Normally that'd never be approved. But she actually dives into the Maze and gets real results.
うん、ちゃんと生徒会長に認められた。合法。: Yep. Properly recognized by the Student Council President. Legal.
いや、違法かどうかは疑ってはないが……\nわざわざなんでここに来たんだ？: No, I'm not doubting whether it's legal or not... Why did you go out of your way to come here?
恐怖の館をしてるって聞いたから。\n楽しみにしてきた。: I heard you were running a House of Horrors. I was looking forward to it, so I came.
いや待て、楽しみにしてるならこんなことをする理由はないだろ。\nフルートたちも気: Wait a second, if you were looking forward to it, there's no reason to do something like this. Flute and the others are knocked out cold...
でも、覚悟の上じゃないの？\n……もしかして、油断してたし時間を間違えてた？: Wait, weren't you guys prepared for it? ...Could it be that you had your guard down and got the time wrong?
いやいや、時間の問題じゃないからな！？: No, no, no, it's not a matter of timing at all!?
……難しい。\nそういえば、この場合どうなるの？: ...This is complicated. By the way, what happens in a situation like this?
どうなるって……そうだな。\n悪意があるなら生徒会に突き出して……: What happens... well. If there was malicious intent, we'd turn you over to the Student Council...
ゲームは失敗？ 負け？: Is the game a fail? A loss?
……えーっと、ちょっと待って？\nまず落ち着いて話を聞いてみようか。: ...Umm, hold on a second? Let's calm down first and listen to what she has to say.
ヒイロさん、なんでこんなことをしたの？\nうちは恐怖の館だけど……何か気に障った: Hiiro-san, why did you do something like this? We're running a House of Horrors, but... did we offend you somehow?
気になんて障ってない。\nむしろ、とても楽しめた。: Not offended at all. In fact, I enjoyed myself thoroughly.
……えーっと、うちの恐怖の館を楽しみに来たの？: ...Umm, so you came because you were looking forward to our House of Horrors?
うん。アトラクション。\n恐怖を楽しめるサバイバルゲーム会場って聞いた。: Yep. As an attraction. I heard it was a survival game arena where you could enjoy horrors.
……ごめん、ちょっと混乱してきた。\nフルートたちを起こしてくるからちょっと聞い: ...Sorry, I'm getting a little confused now. I'm gonna go wake Flute and the others, so could you listen to her for a bit?
ああ、分かった……というか、俺も何となく理解してきたぞ。: Yeah, got it... Though, I'm starting to get the picture myself.
（……つまりは、ヒイロの勘違いだったってことか？）: (...In short, Hiiro just misunderstood the whole thing?)
そうして、エヴィに起こされたフルートたちも交えて、\n何が起きたのかを聞き取って: With Flute and the others awakened by Evi joining in, we gather everyone's account of what happened and finally piece it together.
……纏めると、ヒイロはサバイバルゲーム会場だと思って、\nここにやってきたって訳: ...To sum it up, Hiiro thought this was a survival game venue and came here because of that.
で、普通にゲーム感覚でスタッフが敵役だと思って、\n自分の改造した銃で撃退したわ: And treating it like a normal game, she assumed the staff were enemy roleplayers and took them down with her custom-modded gun.
はぁ……またはた迷惑な勘違いを……\nいやまあ、これが休憩中でよかったよ。: Sigh... What an incredibly troublesome misunderstanding... Though honestly, I'm just glad this happened during our break.
そういう事だったんですねぇ……\nいきなり頭にバチーンって衝撃が走って気絶しちゃ: So that's what happened... A sudden impact hit my head with a thwack and knocked me out cold.
そうだね。\n心配したけど、フルートは安らかに眠ってたよ。: Indeed. We were worried, but Flute was sleeping so peacefully.
いやあ、ビックリしたわ……\nあと、ゴム弾ってとんでもなく痛いのね。: Man, what a shock... Also, rubber bullets hurt ridiculously bad, don't they?
というか、なんでそんな勘違いをしたの？\n他の人に聞けばわかんじゃないかな？: I mean, how did you even make a misunderstanding like that? Wouldn't asking anyone else have cleared it right up?
そういうことを聞く相手はいなかったから。\nここを知ったのも噂話を聞いて興味を引: I didn't have anyone to ask. I only found out about this place because rumors caught my interest.
学園祭の時期は私はあまりやる事がない。\nメイズに潜るのが好きだけど、学園祭だか: I don't have much to do during the school festival. I like diving into the Maze, but it's restricted during festival time.
まあ、それはそうだろうな。\nこういうイベント見回りで生徒会も手が回らないだろう: Well, that makes sense. The Student Council probably has their hands full patrolling event spaces like this.
スカラで興味のある出し物もないから、\n暇を持て余してたらスカラの生徒が噂をして: Since there were no booths at Skalla that caught my eye, I was idling around when I overheard some Skalla students gossiping.
閉じ込められて、お化けに追っかけられたりしながら脱出するゲーム。\nサバイバルゲ: A game where you get trapped and have to escape while being chased by ghosts. I heard it was like a survival game, so I came.
……た、確かにそこだけ聞いたらそう取れなくもない……かな？: ...I-I guess if you only heard that part, it's not impossible to interpret it that way... maybe?
いや、そんな物騒な出し物は生徒会が認めないでしょ。\n……はぁ……本当に、悪意の: No way, the Student Council would never approve such a dangerous booth. ...Sigh... To think I was actually considering malicious sabotage from someone.
ありがとう。退屈だったけど、\n貴方との追いかけっこはとっても楽しかった。: Thank you. I was bored, but playing tag with you was super fun.
噂に聞いてた教導指揮官、思ってたよりも興味深い人だった。: The Instructional Commander from the rumors... You're much more intriguing than I thought.
……そ、そうか。お眼鏡にかなったならよかったが。: ...I-I see. I'm glad I met your standards, then.
……いやいや、そっちで楽しんでも意味はないよね！？\n一歩間違えれば大惨事だった: ...Wait, wait, wait, having fun on that end misses the whole point, doesn't it!? One wrong step and it could've been a total disaster.
ごめんなさい。\nただ、楽しめた感想は伝えるべきだと思って。: I'm sorry. I just felt I should pass along my impression that I had fun.
……まあ、あんまり怒らないでやってくれ。\n勘違いだったし、悪気はなかったんだよ: ...Well, don't get too mad at her. It was an honest misunderstanding with no ill intent.
ヒイロは暴れてはいたものの、\n本人なりにサバイバルゲームだと思って遊んで手加減: Even though Hiiro went wild, she was holding back in her own way, thinking she was just playing a survival game.
ええっと……折角楽しみたいと思ってきてくれましたし、\n勘違いをしちゃったなら許: Umm... She went out of her way to come here wanting to have fun, so if it was just a misunderstanding, I think it's okay to forgive her!
……でも、間違えて迷惑をかけたのは事実。: ...Still, it's a fact that my mistake caused trouble.
罪には罰が必要。\nだから、煮るなり焼くなり好きにしてほしい。: A crime requires punishment. So feel free to boil me or roast me—do as you like.
……こうも自分が悪いと認めて、\n好きにしろって言われると逆に困るわよねぇ。: ...When someone admits fault so readily and tells us to do whatever we want, it actually leaves us at a loss, doesn't it?
んー、まあ被害自体は私達のおでこへのダメージと……\nあー、でも一部の展示物が壊: Hmm, well, the actual damages are just the hits to our foreheads and... Ah, right, a few exhibits did end up broken, huh.
まだ午後の部までは時間があるから、\nみんなで協力すれば直せないかな？: We still have time before the afternoon session, so if we all pitch in, couldn't we fix them?
はい！ エヴィちゃんが演出もアゲアゲにしてくれましたし、\n直せば午前よりももー: Yes! Evi-chan super-charged our production effects, too, so if we fix them up, it'll become an even more amazing House of Horrors than this morning!
そうね！ あたしもインスピレーションが沸いたわ！\nちょっと改良してさらに最高な: Right! I'm brimming with inspiration now too! I'll tweak a few things and make it even more awesome, just watch!
お詫びに手伝っても大丈夫？: Is it okay if I help out as an apology?
壊れた物を直すのも出来る。\n別に私は出し物をしてるわけじゃないから。: I can repair the broken stuff too. It's not like I'm running a booth of my own, anyway.
ヒイロが手伝ってくれるのか。\nそれでいいか？: Hiiro wants to lend a hand. Is that fine with everyone?
うん、それでいいんじゃないかな？\nヒイロさんも反省してるんだろうし……: Yeah, sounds fine to me. Hiiro-san seems genuinely remorseful, too...
いいや、それじゃダメかな。\nここまでやって、ただ手伝うだけってのもね。: Nope, that won't do. Doing all that and just helping out wouldn't be enough.
ふえ？ エヴィちゃん？\nいったい何をやってもらうつもりなんですか？: Fueh? Evi-chan? What on earth are you planning to have her do?
まずは、レイラにちょっと相談したいんだけどさ。: First, I'd like to consult with Layla for a second.
そうそう。\n……で……して……させるっていうのはどう？: Exactly. ...So how about we do... and then make her...?
……なるほど、確かに面白いね。\nそれなら損失は……いやむしろ、プラスかも？: ...I see! That's definitely interesting. With that, our losses... no, wait, we might actually come out in the green!
分かった！ ちょっと今から準備してくる！\n他の準備はそっちに任せるね！: Got it! I'm gonna go make preparations right now! I'll leave the rest of the prep to you guys!
えっ、えええ！？\n何が決まったんですか！？: Eh, eeeh!? What was just decided!?
まあまあ、別に悪い事じゃないよ。\nそれで、ヒイロに聞きたいんだけど……好きにし: Now, now, it's nothing bad. So, I want to ask Hiiro... you said we could do as we like, right?
……ええっと、余り痛いのは困る。: ...Umm, I'd prefer if it doesn't hurt too much.
流石ににこやかなエヴィに怯えているのか、\n少し引いたように答えるヒイロ。: Evidently intimidated by Evi's beaming smile, Hiiro answers while pulling back slightly.
ちょっと、可哀想なことしちゃダメよ！？: Hey, you better not do anything cruel to her!?
流石に俺も生徒会に所属してるからな……\nあんまり酷いことをするのは見過ごせない: I am a member of the Student Council after all... I can't just turn a blind eye if things get too out of hand, you know?
……いや、人の事を何だと思ってるの？\nむしろヒイロにも私達にもメリットがある提: ...Seriously, what do you take me for? This proposal actually benefits both Hiiro and us.
……結局、何をしたらいいの？: ...So, what do you want me to do in the end?
まあ、簡単なお仕事だよ。\n迷惑をかけたならやる事の相場は決まってるでしょ。: Well, it's a simple job. When you cause trouble, the standard way to make amends is already set, isn't it?
やらかした時には……\n体で払ってもらうって相場は決まってるよね♪: When you mess up... paying it off with your body is standard procedure, right?♪
にこやかにそう宣言するエヴィが伝える作戦に、\nその場にいる全員……ヒイロも一緒: At the strategy announced by Evi's smiling face, everyone present—including Hiiro—nodded along in agreement.
そうして、午後の部へ向けて慌てて修繕と準備をして……\n無事に恐怖の館の第二部が: And so, rushing through repairs and preparations for the afternoon session... Act Two of the House of Horrors successfully kicked off.
